reviews.title: Cool‑running, stable, and fully EXPO‑validated on a Ryzen 9 9900X
reviews.comment: Running this BIWIN Black Opal DW100 48GB kit (24GB×2) on a Ryzen 9 9900X system, the 6000 MHz CL28 EXPO profile trained correctly on first boot and held stable under a full multi‑pass MemTest86 validation. All four passes completed with zero errors, including the random‑pattern and hammer tests that typically expose marginal DIMMs or borderline memory‑controller stability on AMD platforms. Thermals were outstanding for a 48GB configuration. With factory heatsinks and good airflow, module temperatures stayed extremely low throughout the run: 28 °C min / 43 °C max / 36 °C average. CPU thermals during the test were also well‑controlled (41 °C / 79 °C / 61 °C), confirming the system wasn’t thermally saturating even during the heavier pattern‑generation phases. Build quality is solid, RGB diffusion is clean, and the kit maintained consistent timing behavior across long‑duration load. For a high‑capacity DDR5 configuration on Ryzen, this is exactly the kind of “set EXPO and forget it” stability you want.
reviews.author: Nimbleo

reviews.title: A pleasant surprise
reviews.comment: Far exceeds expectations. Benchmarking higher than my G.Skill cl26 kit. Great heatsink, they stay cool to the touch. 48gb is a sweet spot; very few people will utilize 64gb, and on the other hand 32gb can start to be a bottleneck in some workstation applications. Very competitive price relative to market conditions as of 3/20/2026.
reviews.author: J. Shannon
